item.tib: sa bcu'i dbang phyug ma cig dpal ldan lha mo'i gsang sgrub mchog thun dngos grub 'byung ba'i gter chen gcod byed dam nyams srog gi spu gri
item.coloph: ces ma cig dpal ldan lha mo'i gsang bsgrub (sgrub/)mchog thun dngos grub 'byung ba'i gter chen/ gcod byed dam nyams srog gi spu gri 'di ni/ chos rgyal be ri rin po che yis gsung gis bskul ma dang / gzhan yang gsang sngags rnying ma'i rjes su 'jug pa'i/ skyes chen dam pa 'ga' yis kyang / 'di ltar dgos shig nan cher yod pa dang / khyad par du mchog sprul byang chub rdo rjes bka' spyi bor phebs pa'i ngor/ rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying po can gyis yar zla'i 'phel phyogs bzang por brtsams pa'i (pas/)phyogs bcur kun tu dar zhing rgyas la gsang ba sngags kyi bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog
